title: Built a tiny AI assistant that works inside WhatsApp / Instagram / Telegram giving lifetime free access to the first 500 early users
author: Dry_Huckleberry_281
selftext:
Hey everyone

I built a lightweight Android tool called **Aido** that tries to solve a personal annoyance: constantly switching apps when you want some help writing or replying to messages. Instead, Aido hooks into any app WhatsApp, Messenger, IG, email — and gives you grammar correction, tone adjustment, smart replies or full-on AI chat without leaving the screen.

If you’re curious, here’s the Play Store link: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rr.aido&hl=en\_IN](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rr.aido&hl=en_IN&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🎯 What I’m doing right now:**

* Giving **lifetime-free access** to the **first 500 users** no strings attached.
* I want early adopters who’ll use it hard, break things, and tell me what sucks (honestly).
* Feedback — bugs, weird behavior, feature requests everything helps.

If you want to try it, just install from the link above, poke around, and let me know what works or doesn’t. Real talk. I’m not here to hype I’m here to build something useful.

Thanks 🙏
